name: Mobinet Darkhan Data Center
notes: Operational geographically redundant data center in Darkhan, listed at Tedy Center, 12th Bag. Local Mongolian press reported Mobicom and Mobinet opened Mongolia's first geographically redundant data center in Darkhan, built to international Tier III/TIA-942-style standards; Data Center Map lists Mobinet Darkhan as an active Darkhan facility.

name: Hunnu City renewable-powered data center development
developer: Erdenes Mongol / Chinggis Khaan Sovereign Wealth Fund
notes: Data Center Dynamics reported Mongolia's sovereign wealth fund is looking to bring in data-center development and highlighted Hunnu, a 31,000-hectare project set up in 2024, as a smart-tech hub candidate using geothermal energy. Hunnu City sources place the development south of Ulaanbaatar near the new Chinggis Khaan International Airport; Mongolian government social posts identify Hunnu/New Zuunmod in Sergelen and Altanbulag sums of Tov aimag. No site-specific MW has been announced.
